findings.message: The deploy_result path is read from the externally-supplied ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS JSON file via jq and used as a filesystem path without sanitization; an adversarially crafted stage-inputs.json could point this to any path, giving an existence oracle for arbitrary files via the -f check.

mkdir -p "$ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" is executed unconditionally when state_file is missing and ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR is set; an attacker who controls that env var can cause arbitrary directory creation before any guard fires.
